scope: Paper proofs with explicit hypotheses; tests are implementation evidence, not universal proof.
independence: Delegated reviewers share a model family; two source implementations use different exact arithmetic and decompositions but the same declared source.

claims.statement: An accessible finite Hankel bank reconstructs every word and an absolutely convergent tagged path sum.
claims.domain: Complex responses on a finite free action monoid.
claims.hypotheses: Authenticated full Hankel rank at most d; measured invertible d-block and shifted/endpoint data; lawful common preparation; sum_a |z_a| ||M_a|| < 1.
claims.quantifiers: Every finite word; every tag family satisfying the norm inequality; every truncation length L.
claims.proof: THEOREM.md section 2; REALIZATION.md CGR-R03/04; COMPLETE_SIGNED.md CS-01.
provenance: Classical weighted-automaton realization and Neumann series; SUCC PO-H2--H5, BF-01.
claims.next_falsification_opportunity: Remove or mutate one premise and compare an unchanged finite bank with a changed target.

claims.statement: Uniform finite-target and completion budgets give a certified completed target on each observation fiber.
claims.domain: Metric-valued targets on a nonempty compatible-model class.
claims.hypotheses: Two actual uniform bounds delta_L and r_L, tending to zero in sum.
claims.quantifiers: Every compatible model and every finite L; pairwise target diameter at most twice the total budget.
implementation_checks: Paper triangle-inequality proof; operator and source-tail calibrations in focused suite.
provenance: Elementary triangle inequality; existing SUCC completion discipline.
claims.next_falsification_opportunity: Supply a model satisfying the displayed budgets while violating the conclusion, or show the proposed budgets are not uniform.

claims.statement: Any five distinct exact raw state readings recover all four source coefficients and the seed.
claims.domain: U_0=s; U_n=16 U_(n-1)+sum_a c_a/(8n-d_a), d=(7,4,3,2), parameters in R^5.
claims.hypotheses: Known source family and clocks; unwrapped nonperturbative exact readings; no extra forcing.
claims.quantifiers: Every ordered five-tuple 0<=t0<...<t4 of finite integer clocks; every parameter vector.
provenance: PR #668 FC-01/02 source-coordinate inverse; new raw-state block-minor interface in this dossier.
claims.next_falsification_opportunity: Change an interval sign, pole order, or source term; rederive the determinant and test its claimed domain.

claims.statement: Five raw scalar readings are necessary on an open free parameter class, including adaptive clocks.
claims.domain: Nonempty open subset of R^5 with deterministic sampling policy.
claims.hypotheses: At most four readings; each next strictly later clock and stopping decision depend only on earlier acquired readings.
claims.quantifiers: Every such policy fails for at least one pair of distinct parameters with the same transcript.
provenance: New explicit transcript-kernel lower bound for the SA-02 experiment; elementary rank-nullity.
adversarial_controls: Source-triggered event times are excluded observations
claims.next_falsification_opportunity: Propose a policy within the exact access model and check its transcript-fiber kernel; smaller priors require a new theorem.

claims.statement: Bounded raw errors give an exact compatible parallelotope, volume, and sharp coordinate errors.
claims.domain: Full R^5 source family with fixed measurement and parameter units.
claims.hypotheses: Invertible sampling matrix; deterministic componentwise raw errors with positive volume widths.
claims.quantifiers: Every center reading and error box; every coordinate bound is individually sharp.
provenance: Linear change of variables; classical operator norm; distinct from #668 local-field Smith volume.
claims.next_falsification_opportunity: Transport the complete error box under a new chart and test equality of the compatible fibers.

claims.statement: Late consecutive five-clock fibers shrink in volume while worst directional sensitivity grows.
claims.domain: Clocks N,...,N+4 in the SA-02 source family.
claims.hypotheses: Fixed positive raw absolute error widths and parameter units.
claims.quantifiers: As N tends to infinity: det R_N ~ (1440/8^10)16^N/N^16; full inverse norm Theta(N^7); sigma_k(C_N)=Theta(N^(-(2k-1))).
claims.proof: SOURCE_ACQUISITION.md SA-04; SOURCE_AUDIT.md section 3, exterior-power proof.

provenance: New explicit Cauchy-minor asymptotic and its knowledge-volume application in this dossier.
adversarial_controls: Different schedules distinguished from cumulative observation
claims.next_falsification_opportunity: Check an altered clock-spacing law or precision scaling; the fixed-consecutive asymptotic cannot be transferred unchanged.

claims.statement: Recovered source parameters generate every finite state and a certified endpoint approximation.
claims.domain: Same four-pole source family.
claims.hypotheses: Authenticated coefficients and seed; M nonnegative; signed chronological target separately specified.
claims.quantifiers: Every M: endpoint tail <= ||c||_1/[15*16^M*(8M+1)]; every finite recurrence clock.
